import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Key Specifications and Trends', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for sensor, color in zip(sensor_types, colors):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=color, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Price by Brand (bar plot - top 10 brands)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_avg_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax2.barh(range(len(brand_avg_price)), brand_avg_price.values, 
                color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(brand_avg_price)), 
                edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(brand_avg_price)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(brand_avg_price.index, fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Brands by Average Price', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(brand_avg_price.values):
    ax2.text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. Camera Evolution: Megapixels and 4K Video over Time
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'has_video_4k': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['megapixels'], 
                 color='#2E86AB', marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='Avg Megapixels')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#2E86AB')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['has_video_4k'] * 100, 
                      color='#A23B72', marker='s', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='4K Video %')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Cameras with 4K Video (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#A23B72')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')
ax3.set_title('Camera Technology Evolution Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 4. Weight Distribution by Body Type (violin plot)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
body_types = df['body_type'].value_counts().head(5).index
df_filtered = df[df['body_type'].isin(body_types)]
sns.violinplot(data=df_filtered, y='body_type', x='weight_grams', 
               ax=ax4, palette='muted', orient='h')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type (Top 5)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
